svg.text: Sequence — editing code and the terminal

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: Both are locked while an agent runs. Edits autosave into a draft version and the running sandbox; a saved version is made on demand or just before the next message.

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: The terminal runs one command at a time and streams its output.

svg.text: SAVE AS A VERSION · or discard

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: TERMINAL

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. type in the editor · 1 s after the last key:

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: code.write({ projectId, path, content })

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. locked? a pending prompt, export, restore or wake → refuse

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: path guard · text only · ≤ 300k chars · valid package.json · secret scan

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. tx (project row locked): DRAFT version edit_<projectId>

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: = every file with this change · removed again if equal to the saved version

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. write the file into the sandbox → the dev server reloads

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: (skipped if the sandbox is gone: the draft rebuilds it later)

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 5. { changed, previewUpdated } → "Saved · preview updated"

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: version.files now returns the draft → unsaved-edits bar

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 6. Save version (code.saveVersion) or the next message (message.send)

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: Retry and Restore refuse while edits are unsaved

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 7. tx: draft → Version N+1 · 0 credits · reply "Saved your edit to … as version N+1"

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: draft deleted (discard instead deletes it and rewrites the saved files into the sandbox)

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 8. message.send only: agent/run → load-project reads the saved edits

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 9. POST /api/terminal { projectId, command }

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: Arcjet · session · rate limit · ownership · command guard · not building

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 10. run in /home/user/app (≤ 100 s, ≤ 200k chars of output)

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 11. stdout / stderr streamed back through the route, then [exit N]

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 12. snapshot the files · confirm deletions with [ -e ]

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: 13. changes merged into the draft (no secrets · AGENTS.md ignored)

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: → they show as unsaved edits

text.font-family: Excalifont8, Excalifont1, Segoe UI Emoji, sans-serif

svg.text: Edits from the terminal, the agent or a restore replace unsaved typing in an open file (with a notice), so the editor never overwrites a newer version.
